title: Isolate integration tests from the dev database (dedicated test DB + safety guard)
tech: Vitest config change + a small runtime guard -- no new dependencies (Node's built-in env-file parsing or a trivial manual parser is enough)
keyConstraints: Root cause, confirmed by reading backend/test/helpers/fixtures.ts and backend/vitest.config.ts: resetAndSeed() runs DELETE FROM on every core table (bookings, availability_rules, availability_exceptions, services, providers, customers, email_jobs, admin_sessions, admin_login_tokens, customer_booking_tokens) inside every integration test's beforeEach, and vitest.config.ts has no DATABASE_URL override of its own -- tests simply inherit whatever DATABASE_URL happens to already be in the process environment when `npm test` runs. Since no separate test database has ever existed in this project, that has in practice always been the real local dev database, meaning every `npm test` run -- including every task's Tester/Reviewer/Release pipeline stage this session -- has been silently wiping dev/seed data and replacing it with a minimal fixture. Fix must NOT depend on ambient shell-exported environment variables at all -- that exact fragility (a stale/wrong value surviving in an already-sourced shell) already caused multiple confusing debugging detours this session, separate from this data-wiping issue. The test database's connection string must come from a dedicated, checked-in-as-example, gitignored-as-real file (backend/.env.test, mirroring the existing backend/.env / backend/.env.example split), parsed directly by vitest.config.ts at config-load time -- never inherited from whatever DATABASE_URL the calling shell happens to have exported. Creating the actual masseur_booking_test database and running the existing migration loop against it is a manual, one-time local setup step -- this project has no migration-runner tooling (an already-accepted gap), so don't try to auto-provision the test database from application or test code; document the manual step clearly instead.
description: Two-part fix. Part 1 (root cause): give tests their own database connection, sourced independently of the dev environment. Add backend/.env.test.example documenting DATABASE_URL for a dedicated test database (same local Postgres container as dev, just a different database name -- e.g. postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/masseur_booking_test -- no new infrastructure needed). Update backend/vitest.config.ts to read backend/.env.test directly (parse the file itself at config-load time -- Node 20's built-in util.parseEnv is available and needs no new dependency) and inject the resulting DATABASE_URL into the test process via Vitest's existing test.env config block (it already sets CORS_ORIGIN there today). If backend/.env.test is missing, the config should fail immediately with a clear message pointing at .env.test.example -- never silently fall through to an ambient DATABASE_URL. Part 2 (defense in depth): add a guard, called at the top of resetAndSeed() before any DELETE runs, that inspects the resolved database name from the pool's connection string and throws immediately with a clear error if it doesn't contain 'test' -- so that even a future misconfiguration (a missing .env.test, a copy-paste mistake, a CI environment set up wrong) fails loudly instead of quietly deleting real data the way it has been.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/.env.test.example is added, documenting DATABASE_URL for a dedicated local test database, mirroring the style/comments already used in backend/.env.example

backend/vitest.config.ts parses backend/.env.test directly at config-load time and sets DATABASE_URL in the test.env block from it -- if the file is missing, vitest fails fast with an error naming the missing file and pointing at .env.test.example, rather than falling through to any ambient/inherited DATABASE_URL

A safety guard runs before any DELETE in resetAndSeed() (or a shared helper it calls) that throws immediately if the resolved database name doesn't contain 'test', naming the offending database in the error message
backend/.env.test is added to .gitignore (mirroring how .env is already handled at the repo root) -- only .env.test.example is committed

A short setup note is added (agents/context_template.md or a backend README) documenting the one-time manual step: create the masseur_booking_test database, run the existing migration loop against it before running tests for the first time
The full existing backend test suite passes when run against a freshly created, freshly migrated masseur_booking_test database

Manually verified as part of this task: exporting DATABASE_URL in a shell to point at the real dev database, then running npm test, does NOT touch dev data -- either because the test config ignores that ambient value entirely in favor of .env.test, or because the safety guard blocks it outright; dev data must survive a test run regardless of what's exported in the calling shell
securityConsiderations: None beyond correctness/data-safety -- this is a dev-tooling-only fix. No production code path changes at all (src/db/pool.ts and src/config/db.ts, used by the running app, are untouched); this only changes how the test process resolves its database connection.
